About GreenTaak

One vineyard, one factory, one point of contact

GreenTaak is a grower and exporter of Iranian raisins based in Takestan, in Qazvin province — a region known for centuries for the quality of its grapes and its dry, sun-filled climate ideal for natural drying.

We control the entire process ourselves: our own vineyard supplies the grapes, our own drying yards and facility turn them into raisins, and our own team sorts, grades and packs every order. That means fewer intermediaries, consistent quality batch after batch, and the flexibility to supply exactly the volume a buyer needs.

Whether you are sourcing a single trial shipment or a recurring container order, we work directly with importers, distributors and food manufacturers to get it there.

Takestan, Qazvin Vineyard and factory on the same site
Our Products

Six raisins, one standard of quality

Every variety is grown in our vineyard and processed at our facility in Takestan, and can be supplied loose, bulk-packed, or in your own custom packaging — printed with your brand or to your exact specification.

Golden Raisin

Plump, light golden raisins with a mild, honeyed sweetness — also known as the Californian Raisin, favoured for snacking, baking and confectionery.

Acid Raisin

Produced with a traditional dipping method that gives a bright amber colour and thin, tender skin. A classic Iranian export grade.

Also known as Tizabi Raisin

Sun-Dried Raisin

Dried naturally in open air with no dipping treatment, giving a deeper amber-brown colour and a fuller, more concentrated flavour.

Seedless Raisin

Small, tender and completely seed-free, sorted for consistent size — suited to bakeries, cereal and snack manufacturers.

Seeded Raisin

Traditional seeded raisin with a fuller body and richer taste, popular across Middle Eastern and South Asian markets.

Zante Currants

Large, dark and chewy, sun-dried on the vine for an intense, almost fruit-leather sweetness. A specialty snacking raisin.

Also known as Moviz Raisin
Our Process

From vine to shipping container

Not every raisin follows the same path. Sun-dried varieties are cured naturally in the open air, while our Golden and Acid raisins are dipped and dried in ovens — but every batch is grown, processed and packed at the same site in Takestan.

01

Harvest

Grapes are hand-picked from our own vineyard in Takestan at peak ripeness, for every variety we produce.

02a

Sun-Drying

Our Sun-Dried, Seedless, Seeded and Zante Currant raisins are spread across open-air wooden trays and cured naturally under the sun — no dipping, no chemical treatment.

02b

Dipping & Oven-Drying

Our Golden raisins are dipped in an acid solution and sulfur-fumigated; our Acid (Tizabi) raisins are dipped in an acid-oil solution. Both are then dried in temperature-controlled ovens rather than in the sun.

03

Sorting & Grading

Whichever path they took, all raisins are cleaned, destemmed and sorted by size, colour and variety.

04

Packing & Export

Orders are packed to buyer specification — bulk, retail-ready, or in the buyer's own custom packaging — and prepared for shipment.

Where We Export

Trusted by buyers across the region — and beyond

Our main markets today include Pakistan, Russia, Armenia, Turkey, Iraq and the United Arab Emirates. That said, GreenTaak raisins are not limited to these countries — if you're ordering from anywhere else in the world, we can still supply and ship to you.
